ch0116_90_hikari/0101_0701_02_10:
I’ll continue to lead the way today, so be
sure to keep up!
ch0116_90_hikari/7101_0701_01_10:
Who’s the strongest among all the
Neo Champions?
ch0116_90_hikari/7101_0701_03_10:
Well, that’s what I’d like to think, but
everyone is so tough.
ch0116_90_hikari/7101_0701_04_10: Who do you think is the strongest?
ch0116_90_hikari/7102_0701_01_10:
It’s hard to bring out your usual strength
when you’re on a grand stage.
ch0116_90_hikari/7102_0701_02_10:
That’s why I try to battle where lots of
people gather!
ch0116_90_hikari/7102_0701_03_10: I got that advice from Fantina and Lisia!
ch0116_90_hikari/7102_0701_04_10:
They’re both used to being in the spotlight,
so they know what they’re talking about!
ch0116_90_hikari/7103_0701_01_10:
Do you think this outfit suits me? I like how
pretty and stylish it is!
ch0116_90_hikari/7103_0701_02_10:
I’ll show everyone battles as dazzling as
this outfit—as a Neo Champion should!
ch0116_90_hikari/7104_0701_01_10:
The other day, Irida and the others taught me
about Palkia.
ch0116_90_hikari/7104_0701_02_10:
They shared all kinds of myths and legends
of the Hisui region.
ch0116_90_hikari/7104_0701_03_10: So I know a little more about Palkia now!
ch0116_90_hikari/7105_0701_01_10:
Do you have any goals you want to
accomplish, [Name:PlayerNickname ]?
ch0116_90_hikari/7105_0701_02_10:
My goal right now is to get even stronger
and lead everyone with positivity!
ch0116_90_hikari/7105_0701_03_10: If you’re ever feeling stuck, come talk to me!
ch0116_90_hikari/1701_0701_01_10: Hey! There you are! Here’s a present!
ch0116_90_hikari/1701_0702_01_10: I hope it helps you out!
ch0116_90_hikari/2501_0701_01_10:
Now that I’m a Neo Champion, I want to be
a proper leader to you, too...
ch0116_90_hikari/2501_0701_02_10:
but I guess we’re still rivals and friends like
before.
ch0116_90_hikari/2501_0701_03_10:
Instead of focusing on who’s better, let’s
help each other get stronger!
ch0116_90_hikari/2501_0702_01_10:
The trust between you and your Pokémon is
truly wonderful!
ch0116_90_hikari/2501_0702_02_10:
Palkia and I are pretty solid too, though!
After all, the possibilities of sync pairs
are endless!
ch0116_90_hikari/2511_0701_01_10:
Lucas and I are friends, but as fellow Neo
Champions, we’re also rivals that support
each other!
ch0116_90_hikari/2511_0701_02_10:
I wonder what kind of battles I’ll have with
Lucas and his Dialga... I’m overflowing with
excitement just thinking about it!
ch0116_90_hikari/2511_0702_01_10:
The Legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh are full
of mystery!
ch0116_90_hikari/2511_0702_02_10: Let’s ask Cynthia about them sometime!
ch0116_90_hikari/3001_0701_01_10:
I’m full of energy this morning! I’ll need it to
set a good example, like a Neo Champion
should!
ch0116_90_hikari/3003_0701_01_10:
I can’t lose focus, even in the afternoon!
Neo Champions always give their utmost!
ch0116_90_hikari/3005_0701_01_10:
After all my effort today, I’m sure I’ll sleep
like a log...but I’ll be back in action
tomorrow!
